clue.text: Time limit that rules out all telephone conversation

definitions.meaning: a fixed cut-off point by which work must be finished

definitions.text: that rules out all telephone conversation
definitions.meaning: read as two words, a ... is a telephone connection with no signal, so nobody can talk on it

explanation.definitionFit: A cut-off date for submission is the usual sense; a phone wire gone silent is the literal reading of the two words.

clue.text: Spot a rising doctor, one who is getting on

parts.note: a spot is a dot

indicators.note: in a down clue, rising means the word for doctor is read from the bottom up

explanation.surface: A doctor stands up to treat a blemish on an elderly patient.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'rising' reads the abbreviation upwards; 'getting on' means ageing, not progressing.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone getting on is ageing, and a dotard is an old person grown feeble in mind.

clue.text: Acts in a peculiar way-obviously!

indicators.note: doing something in a peculiar way suggests the letters are set out oddly, a rearrangement

explanation.surface: Someone behaving strangely, and plainly so.
explanation.walkthrough: The letters of ACTS IN rearrange into the answer, and the whole clue also describes it: playing the fool is acting oddly, as the exclamation stresses.
explanation.definitionFit: Antics are capers or silly pranks, which is exactly behaving in a peculiar manner.

clue.text: Neither do they spin 51 fibs

parts.note: LI is 51 in Roman numerals
fibs are lies

explanation.surface: A quotation about flowers that do no work, oddly followed by a count of untruths.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition quotes the Sermon on the Mount: 'Consider the lilies of the field, how they grow; they toil not, neither do they spin.'
explanation.definitionFit: The Bible verse says these field flowers neither toil nor spin, so the phrase points straight to them.

clue.text: Sentry with a luminous face for a time

definitions.meaning: a guard on duty through the hours of darkness keeps watch

definitions.text: with a luminous face for a time
definitions.meaning: a timepiece whose glowing dial can be read in the dark tells the time at night

explanation.definitionFit: A guard keeping lookout after dark stands this duty; a wristwatch with a glowing dial is a timepiece for after-dark use.

clue.text: Pursued trade as a metal engraver

definitions.meaning: to chase metal is to engrave or emboss it, so working at that craft is this verb

explanation.definitionFit: Ran after is one sense; an engraver who decorates metal by embossing has done that work.

clue.text: If not a topper, then bowler is needed to perform it

definitions.text: If not a topper, then bowler is needed to perform it

parts.words: If not a topper, then bowler is needed to perform it
parts.note: a conjuring feat with headgear could use a top hat, but in cricket a bowler taking three wickets with successive balls does the same-named feat

explanation.surface: A magician who has mislaid a top hat makes do with a bowler for the act.
explanation.walkthrough: Both 'topper' and 'bowler' read as hats; the bowler is also the cricketer, and three wickets from three balls is the cricket feat.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase names both a trick with headgear and a bowler's three wickets in three consecutive deliveries.

clue.text: A boy smothered in dirt has dressing

indicators.note: something smothered in a substance is covered by it, so one piece sits inside the other

parts.note: dirt is soil
a lad is a boy

explanation.surface: A child covered in mud is having a wound dressed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'smothered in' places the boy and his article inside the dirt; 'dressing' is a salad dressing, not a bandage.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a salad dressing, an oil for pouring over leaves.

clue.text: Drops of French perfumery

parts.note: DE is French for 'of'
perfumery here means perfumes collectively, which are scents

explanation.surface: Drops of perfume from a French maker.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Drops of French perfumery' reads as dabs of scent; 'Drops' is the definition, falls or declines.
explanation.definitionFit: Drops in height are falls, and a fall or downward slope is another word for this.

clue.text: TT League organised period of tuition

indicators.note: organised means arranged anew, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A motorcycle racing league runs a training course.
explanation.walkthrough: The TT is the Isle of Man motorcycle race; its letters with LEAGUE are rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: Tutelage is instruction or guardianship, a spell of being taught.

clue.text: They add to a clown's standing

definitions.text: They add to a clown's standing

parts.words: They add to a clown's standing
parts.note: standing reads as reputation, but means the clown's height when upright, raised by tall poles strapped to the legs

explanation.surface: Things that improve a circus clown's reputation.
explanation.definitionFit: Circus clowns walk on tall poles fixed to their legs, which add height when standing.

clue.text: Make a new effort to amuse oneself

definitions.meaning: to refresh oneself with leisure, the verb behind recreation

explanation.definitionFit: With a hyphen it means make once more; as one word it means take leisure, as in recreation.

clue.text: Card game that ends with two banks

definitions.meaning: a trick-taking game for four players in partnerships
a crossing over a river has an end on each bank

explanation.definitionFit: It is a partnership card game and also a span whose two ends rest on opposite banks of a river.

clue.text: First-rate face-saver for anyone in charge

parts.note: super means excellent
a visor shields the face

explanation.surface: A top-quality way to save face for whoever is boss.
explanation.walkthrough: 'face-saver' looks like the idiom for avoiding humiliation; here it is a literal shield for the face.
explanation.definitionFit: A manager or overseer is the person in charge of others.

clue.text: Post-graduate teachers take in extra share to provide written work

parts.note: an MA, a Master of Arts, is a post-graduate degree

indicators.note: the union takes in the other piece, holding it inside

parts.note: the NUT was the National Union of Teachers in Britain
scrip is a share certificate, especially new shares issued free to shareholders

explanation.surface: Graduate teachers get bonus shares for producing a piece of writing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'take in' sets the extra share inside the union; the NUT was a British teachers' union, and scrip is a stock-market term.
explanation.definitionFit: A handwritten or typed text, such as an author's draft, is written work.

clue.text: Chance police department being taken in by foreign coinage

indicators.note: one piece taken in by another is held inside it

parts.note: a cent is a coin of the US and other countries, foreign to a British setter
the CID is the Criminal Investigation Department of British police

explanation.surface: Detectives are fooled by foreign money by pure luck.
explanation.walkthrough: 'being taken in by' sets the detectives inside the coin; a cent is not British money, hence 'foreign'.
explanation.definitionFit: Something happening by chance, without design, is an unplanned event.

clue.text: Jeopardise make-up

annotationWithheld.why: Clue as held, 'Jeopardise make-up (8)', has no fodder for 'make-up' to rearrange; the original likely had words such as 'green and' that the OCR dropped, and no search found it.

clue.text: Older but confused and worried

indicators.note: confused means mixed up, so the letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: Someone growing older, muddled and anxious.
explanation.definitionFit: Being anxious and uneasy is the same as being bothered or distressed.

clue.text: Shrunk from being bound to undertake the job

definitions.text: being bound to undertake the job
definitions.meaning: signed up under a legal agreement to do the work

explanation.definitionFit: Muscles shrink or tighten in one sense; a firm signed up by agreement to do work is the other.

clue.text: Albert raising cap to a woolly beast

parts.note: Al is short for Albert

indicators.note: in a down clue, raising lifts the word upwards, so it is read bottom to top

explanation.surface: Albert tips his cap to a sheep-like animal.
explanation.definitionFit: This South American animal, related to the llama, is bred for its soft wool.

clue.text: Language suggesting elegance

explanation.definitionFit: It is the tongue of Poland, and with a small p it means refinement or finish.

clue.text: Maybe a big boxer likely to erupt

definitions.text: Maybe a big boxer likely to erupt

parts.words: Maybe a big boxer likely to erupt
parts.note: a boxer is someone who puts goods into boxes, a big box being a crate; the volcano part points to the hollow at a volcano's top

explanation.surface: A heavyweight fighter with a short temper.
explanation.walkthrough: 'boxer' wants to be a fighter; it is one who packs things into crates, and the volcano's mouth is the other sense.
explanation.definitionFit: One who packs into large boxes is a crate-filler, and the bowl-shaped mouth of a volcano carries the same name.

clue.text: One automobile America regarded as being a classic high-flier

parts.note: one is I as a Roman numeral
an automobile is a car
US is short for the United States of America

explanation.surface: An American car seen as an ambitious classic model.
explanation.walkthrough: 'classic' means from Greek myth: the boy who flew too near the sun on wax wings.
explanation.definitionFit: In Greek myth this son of Daedalus flew on wax and feather wings until the sun melted them.

clue.text: One who lied over dissimulation maybe

definitions.text: One who lied over dissimulation maybe

indicators.note: dissimulation is disguise, so the letters are disguised by rearranging them

explanation.surface: A liar keeps lying to cover up the truth.
explanation.walkthrough: The letters of LIED OVER are disguised into the answer, and the whole clue describes a wrongdoer who lies.
explanation.definitionFit: A wrongdoer or sinner might well lie to hide what was done.

clue.text: Swallow returning north-east to Arab war zone

indicators.note: returning means coming back, so the abbreviation is read in reverse

parts.note: NE is the compass abbreviation for north-east
the Gulf, the Persian Gulf, was the scene of the Gulf Wars

explanation.surface: A bird flies back from the north-east to the Middle East conflict.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Swallow' looks like the bird; it is the verb. 'returning' reads the compass abbreviation backwards.
explanation.definitionFit: To swallow up something is to engulf it, overwhelming it completely.

clue.text: Yet world-weary people may regard such literature as captivating

definitions.text: Yet world-weary people may regard such literature as captivating

parts.words: Yet world-weary people may regard such literature as captivating
parts.note: readers tired of the real world enjoy fiction that lets them get away from it, so they find it captivating

explanation.surface: Jaded readers still find some books gripping.
explanation.walkthrough: The kind of fiction that lets weary readers flee reality wins them over.
explanation.definitionFit: Literature offering an escape from everyday life is called by this adjective.

clue.text: A vehement speech for one in commerce

indicators.note: one piece is placed in the other, inside it

parts.note: commerce is trade
one is I as a Roman numeral

explanation.surface: An angry speech made on behalf of someone in business.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' puts I inside TRADE, after its T.
explanation.definitionFit: A long, angry outburst or rant is a forceful speech.

clue.text: Nose rest

definitions.meaning: the nose is the organ one draws air through

explanation.definitionFit: The nose is what one inhales through, and a pause to recover is a short rest from work.
